Name: Inaka no Ie - Countryside House
Author: fiveTrillionElves
Description:
This mod uses Content Patcher to replace the default farmhouse with one inspired by rural Japanese architecture. The mod currently features overlays for all base game seasons and weather, and masks to change the coloration of the third level house. The house is meant to work with the Vibrant Pastoral recolor, but shouldn't look too out of place with some others.

Overlays likely won't work with any custom weather mods, apologies!
